##### Project general facts

Habtoor Grand Residences is a luxury high-rise tower set within the Habtoor Grand resort on Jumeirah Beach, rising from a ground floor to forty-nine residential floors. Glass facades, clean vertical lines and dynamic contours create a striking silhouette along the shoreline. The project offers two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, along with townhouses and penthouses, with most residences oriented towards the Arabian Gulf, Dubai Marina, Bluewaters and Palm Jumeirah.

Residents enjoy waterfront living with private beach access and the use of the resort's five-star facilities. Amenities include a rooftop infinity pool, a fully equipped gymnasium, a spa with steam room, sauna and jacuzzi, an outdoor tennis court and a kids' play area. Multiple restaurants and bars sit within the resort, while high-speed elevators, valet and secured parking and round-the-clock security with CCTV add everyday comfort and peace of mind for residents and their guests.

Interiors are designed in a contemporary style, with spacious layouts, panoramic windows and private terraces or balconies that extend living spaces towards the sea. Open living and dining areas are filled with natural light and framed by sweeping views of the coastline and the marina skyline. Kitchens are fully equipped with quality appliances, and bathrooms are finished with modern fixtures. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Beach Residence is one of Dubai's most popular waterfront communities, stretching along a wide sandy beach next to Dubai Marina. The Walk at JBR and The Beach bring together cafes, restaurants, shops and entertainment along the seafront, while Bluewaters Island and Dubai Harbour lie just across the water. The area combines a relaxed resort atmosphere with the energy of a vibrant urban district.

Dubai Marina, Bluewaters and the JBR beachfront are within walking distance, and Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis The Palm and Atlantis The Royal are a short drive away. Mall of the Emirates and Burj Al Arab are easily reached via Sheikh Zayed Road, and the Dubai Tram and Metro connect residents with the wider city. Dubai Hills Mall and Dubai International Airport are also within comfortable driving distance.

Jumeirah Beach Residence is a freehold destination with strong appeal for international buyers, holiday home owners and long-term residents. Direct beach access, a dense lifestyle offer and constant tourist demand support premium short-term and long-term rental income. Its iconic seafront position and limited supply of new beachfront towers underpin long-term value and resilient resale prospects for both end users and investors.
